scope: Shared threshold/adaptive profile exclusion; static 617.42 analysis
findings: The examined type3 threshold setter can set auxiliary reason bit 2 (mask 0x4) for mapped supported roles.
The available adaptive getter reports only whether the complete reason word is zero.
The examined adaptive setter changes shared bit 1 (mask 0x2), not bit 2, without a per-client counted ownership contract.
Restoring the earlier numeric threshold therefore does not establish restoration of the shared reason state.
Scaled integer SET input also requires representability checking to restore exact captured raw threshold values.
No known independent getter or reversible bit-2 contract currently fills this gap; repeating the aggregate read would not resolve it.
product_decision: Keep shared idle thresholds and adaptive policy outside saved and combined profiles. Existing manual controls retain their stated request/readback limitations.
completion_evidence_needed: A qualified independent affected-state read and reversible operation/lifetime contract, followed by exact raw pair, peer and shared-state verification.
limitations: Static findings apply to the examined binary and paths; no universal firmware semantics, physical effect or new hardware experiment is claimed.
